archive_files.evidence: WebDAV PROPFIND Multi-Status 207 response parsed into exact file entries and byte lengths.
archive_files.notes: Component is composed of exactly 3 split tar.gz archives totaling 18.57 GB.

split_structure.value: Independent archives divided by split: sd2-sp_training.tar.gz, sd2-sp_validation.tar.gz, sd2-sp_testing.tar.gz

download_separate_splits.evidence: HEAD query returned HTTP 200 with Content-Length 2172017290 and Content-Type application/gzip.
download_separate_splits.notes: Enables acquiring small split subsets (e.g., validation 2.17 GB or testing 2.04 GB) without downloading full 18.57 GB.

download_separate_categories.evidence: Categories are bundled inside split tar.gz archives.
download_separate_categories.notes: Category isolation must be performed locally post-extraction.

batch_variant_organization.value: 6 edited variants per inpainting task instance (2 masks: segm and bbox * 3 batch variations each)
batch_variant_organization.request_method: Official specification cross-referenced with paper arXiv:2407.11566 Table 1
batch_variant_organization.evidence: 18,744 total SD2-sp images / 3,124 instances = 6 variants per instance; 2,046 in val, 2,058 in test, 14,640 in train.
batch_variant_organization.notes: All 6 edited variants share the same authentic source image background.

select_one_variant_per_source.value: Supported via post-extraction filtering and manifest selection
select_one_variant_per_source.request_method: Static analysis of TGIF filename structure
select_one_variant_per_source.evidence: Filename contains mask type (segm/bbox) and variation index (_0.png, _1.png, _2.png).
select_one_variant_per_source.notes: The data loader can deterministically pick variation 0 of segm mask to ensure 1:1 pairing with authentic image.

resume_support.notes: Downloader must use atomic .part file pattern with integrity verification.
